name: Nafqa
source: Nafqa is mechanical doll about 70 centimeters tall and one of the "Magical Skilled Shells" (Madou Koukaku). She continues to work as the aide of Olfan Zairud and secretly is in love with him. Out of the four Moon that exist she represents and takes name of the Mirror Moon Goddess Nafqas governing over "Mirror Moon".
